events.address: See dated occurrence: Sephora Meatpacking or Sephora Union Square, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: Two-stop NYC K-beauty tour celebrating Yepoda's U.S. Sephora launch, with product trial, games and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: No purchase is necessary to attend or receive the advertised freebies. Exclusive free gifts are while supplies last, with chances to win Sephora gift cards and full-size products. Separate gifts-with-purchase require $40+ or $60+ Sephora purchases.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. Gifts with purchase are separate from the no-purchase-necessary freebies. Eventbrite provides free tickets; current organizer pages do not state an approval step or door-discretion rule.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19: Meatpacking, 12-6 PM, Sephora 21-27 9th Ave / activation on 13th Street in front of Sephora. Sunday Sept. 20: Union Square, 12-6 PM, Sephora 40 E 14th St / activation on Broadway between E 13th and E 12th Streets.

events.event_name: Max Mara Le Parfum NYC Pop-Up
events.address: Macy's Herald Square Plaza, 151 West 34th Street, New York, NY 10001
events.what_it_is: Open-air launch pop-up for Max Mara Le Parfum outside Macy's Herald Square with an interactive scent journey, games, photo moments and giveaways.
events.what_is_free: Complimentary gelato and fragrance samples are advertised, plus chances to win giveaways, while supplies last.
events.caveats: Eventbrite lists free tickets. Samples, gelato and prizes are promotional inventory and should not be treated as guaranteed late in the day.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19, 10 AM-6 PM at Macy's Herald Square Plaza, 151 W 34th St.

events.address: Magnolia Bakery, 401 Bleecker Street, New York, NY 10014
events.what_it_is: Launch pop-up for LONDONTOWN's Magnolia Bakery-inspired nail-lakur collection.
events.what_is_free: The first 100 guests in line receive a free Banana Pudding dessert and Banana Pudding lakur. After that, the free lakur requires a purchase while supplies last.
events.caveats: The no-purchase free dessert + lakur is limited to the first 100 guests. Later promotional product requires purchase and remains while supplies last.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19 starting at 11 AM. Current event listings give an 11 AM-1 PM activation window; arrive early for the first-100 giveaway.

events.event_name: TRUBAR × Cha Cha Matcha TRU Matcha Experience
events.address: Cha Cha Matcha, 922 Broadway, New York, NY 10010
events.what_it_is: Launch activation for TRUBAR's Love You So Cha Cha Matcha protein bar and Cha Cha Matcha collaboration.
events.what_is_free: The first 50 guests receive limited-edition merch and a ticket to try the new menu items and matcha protein bars. Select guests may receive a golden ticket for a year of TRUBAR.
events.caveats: First-50 merch and sampling are limited. Golden tickets are only for select guests. Collaboration shirts/pouches and regular café menu items may be paid products.
events.practical_notes: Saturday Sept. 19 at Cha Cha Matcha Flatiron, 922 Broadway. Secondary event listing gives 8 AM-6 PM; the current press release independently confirms the Sept. 19 Flatiron launch but not the full operating window.

events.address: 50 2nd Avenue and 184 7th Avenue South, New York, NY
events.what_it_is: Three-day takeover celebrating Conair Cake Pop Hair Dryer colorways with sweet treats, photo moments and giveaways at two Lil Sweet Treat locations.
events.what_is_free: Hair accessories are advertised while supplies last. Cake Pop Hair Dryers are giveaways with purchase for the first 100 qualifying visitors each day, so they are not general freebies.
events.caveats: Do not describe the hair dryer as free without purchase: current listing explicitly ties that giveaway to purchase. Free accessories are while supplies last. Current sources establish open public access, not advance RSVP.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18-20. Average Socialite lists both East Village (50 2nd Ave) and West Village (184 7th Ave S) locations as 11 AM-11 PM; NYC for FREE separately lists a West Village activation window of 11 AM-5 PM, so the later hours have a source discrepancy. Occurrences use the narrower independently corroborated West Village window and flag the broader listing in details.

events.what_it_is: DedCool's first NYC cafe-and-retail pop-up, built around the Mocha Magic fragrance launch with drinks, fragrance sampling, merch and shopping.
events.what_is_free: Fragrance sampling is available and the first 50 people in line each day receive a special gift. Gifts with purchase and retail merchandise are separate paid offers.
events.caveats: Partiful has a guest list, but independent current coverage describes the retail pop-up as open to the public/walk-ins; RSVP is not established as guaranteed or required admission. First-50 gifts are limited each day.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 18-20, 9 AM-6 PM daily at 262 Mott St. RSVP is available on Partiful; arrive early for the first-50 gift.

events.what_it_is: Immersive handmade sculptural reconstruction of a Chanel-style boutique by Tom Sachs, curated by Colby Mugrabi. It is not an official Chanel collaboration.
events.what_is_free: Admission to the exhibition is free during public hours.
events.caveats: Space is described as extremely limited. The installation is not an official Chanel collaboration. No advance RSVP requirement is established in current public information.
events.practical_notes: Runs Sept. 11-Oct. 10 at 245 Centre St. Public hours: Thursdays and Fridays 6-8 PM; Saturdays 1-6 PM. Closed to the public Sunday-Wednesday under the published schedule.
